summary: Implemented every stub in the 34 assigned statsmodels files: elastic net coordinate descent, the modechoice loader, the Baxter-King filter, Yuen and Box covariance tests, the trimmed-mean class, count-data and robust LM/CM diagnostics, AutoReg/ar_select_order, VARMA helpers, the SARIMAX state-space model and results, and the PSS simulator, checking each numerically against reference values where the package imported. The last full-suite result I saw was none, since no full-suite run was made; targeted runs were 7/8 in test_multivariate.py (test_covmat fails on a Bartlett constant) and 7/8 in test_robust_compare.py (failure is in oneway.py, not an assigned file), while the AR and SARIMAX test modules are still blocked by other builders' statespace and OLS files.
